snippet.title: Truck Driver - Hidden Places & Damage System DLC Trailer
snippet.description:
Truck Driver Hidden Places & Damage System DLC is now available for free!
Join our Discord server: https://discord.gg/soedesco

Follow SOEDESCO®!
Game Page: https://www.soedesco.com/truckdriver/
Newsletter: https://bit.ly/2wsfR4f
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/soedesco
Twitter: https://twitter.com/soedesco
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Soedesco
Instagram: https://instagram.com/soedesco

About ‘Hidden Places & Damage System’ DLC
Get ready to hit the road and discover hidden places and new vehicles. Drive safe though, since a new damage system shows visual damage on your truck and other vehicles at the point of impact. With three hidden places, you can search for unknown roads and unlock new achievements/trophies. You can also spot five brand-new vehicles in traffic, including a tow truck and minibus. So drive responsibly and go exploring! 

Features 
- Get visual 3D damage with dents and scratches on your truck and other vehicles 
- Find three hidden places that are off the map and unlock new achievements/trophies 
- Spot five new vehicles: a minibus, classic muscle car, tow truck, box truck and pick-up truck 
- Discover your clients’ new look with revamped character art 

#SOEDESCO #TruckDriverGame
